add.heading: Add to your calendar
add.hint: Or download the file and open it in any calendar app.

connection.heading: Google Calendar sync
connection.disconnected: Your calendar is not connected. Connect it and your sessions are added automatically, and updated if the time changes.
connection.connected: Your calendar has been connected since <bdi>{since}</bdi>.
connection.scope: We ask for the narrowest permission there is: writing and updating events, nothing more.
connection.privacy: Nobody can read the connection tokens, not you and not your organisation's admin. Disconnecting deletes them immediately.
connection.afterDisconnect: Your calendar is disconnected. Events already added stay as they are, but they will no longer update.
connection.error: That could not be done. Try again.

synced.heading: Synced sessions
synced.empty: Nothing synced yet. Reserve a seat and it is added to your calendar.
synced.count: {count, plural, =0 {no sessions} one {one session} other {{value} sessions}}
synced.failedHint: We retry automatically. Your booking stands either way.
